description: This file defines the RandomGeneratorFactory class, which provides static utility methods for creating RandomGenerator instances that wrap Java's java.util.Random objects. It includes methods for creating generators and converting seed representations.

classes.name: RandomGeneratorFactory
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to create and configure RandomGenerator instances, and seed conversion.

methods.name: createRandomGenerator
methods.description: Creates a RandomGenerator that wraps a given java.util.Random instance, exposing methods for various random data generation.

methods.name: convertToLong
methods.description: Converts an array of integer seeds into a single long seed value, using a prime-based combination.
